notes.title: Notice of Change in Marketing Strategy
notes.content:
For the past three years, our team has pursued the dream of markerless VR motion capture, offering our software for free (though the results were admittedly mixed). This past year, we achieved a major breakthrough, developing a brand-new motion capture algorithm that addresses previous issues of low accuracy, poor recognition, and slow response. Now, we're shifting our marketing strategy to find passionate individuals willing to try our markerless VR motion capture technology. We invite you to share your experiences and feedback, helping us to improve and grow together.

  We invite you to experience our revolutionary markerless VR motion capture for the price of half a cup of coffee!

Notes:
1. You will need to provide your own motion capture device. Purchase link: https://www.orbbec.com/products/tof-camera/femto-bolt/#    
2. To stay updated on the project's progress, join our Discord community:  https://discord.gg/2KfmcJyq

notes.title: November 13th JumpWork 1.0 New Version Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Main Updates[/h1]

[h2]Motion Capture Solutions[/h2]

1.Added dual-camera technology solution
2.Optimized existing single-camera solution

[h2]Feature Updates[/h2]

1.Added motion demonstration function
2.Added motion capture recording and BVH format motion capture export
3.Optimized SteamVR usage process

[h2]UI Optimization[/h2]

1.Unified overall UI color scheme
2.Optimized component positioning and layout
3.Added initialization interface

[h1]Feature Overview[/h1]

[h2]Dual-Camera Usage Process[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43756236/70eb3eaf3c00ed190eb935c779cc49a4ece9cad7.png[/img]

1.Select dual-camera mode in the camera mode option in the upper left corner
2.If calibration hasn't been performed before, you need to calibrate before use (to align the coordinate systems of both cameras)
(1)Open the dual-camera calibration interface and place the provided calibration paper between the two cameras to find the alignment reference points
(2)Click start calibration. When both cameras can recognize the ArUco code on the calibration paper, alignment calculation will begin. When the progress bar reaches 100%, calibration is complete, and you'll enter the calibration verification interface
(3)In the verification interface, you can use the mouse to view the aligned point cloud. If the point cloud doesn't show obvious discontinuities, the coordinate system alignment is successful. You can then exit calibration mode and start using dual cameras.
3.Motion capture, SteamVR games, and other features can only be used after dual-camera calibration and camera connection are complete

[h2]Motion Capture Usage Process[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43756236/1fe85d2433317f7864aac09649e97c0df7b3e509.png[/img]
1.With cameras successfully connected, open the motion capture interface
2.Import FBX model
3.Click start motion capture to begin real-time motion capture; the FBX model will mirror your movements
4.Click stop motion capture to stop the FBX model's motion capture
5.Click export motion capture to export the BVH motion capture file to the specified folder

[h2]SteamVR Usage Process[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43756236/03e176bcb4999abcff03df531d6860705f43f9a9.png[/img]
1.With cameras and SteamVR successfully connected, open the SteamVR alignment interface
2.Enter the SteamVR virtual space and click the alignment button on the left-hand overlay virtual screen to align the camera coordinates with the SteamVR space
3.Face the camera (in single-camera mode), assume an A-pose, and press the grip buttons to complete the alignment process
4.After successful alignment, the current motion capture frame rate will be displayed. You can then check the virtual trackers attached to your body. If the tracker positions don't match your actual body positions in the real world, please repeat the alignment steps above
5.Start your game in SteamVR

notes.title: 2023/8/3 UPDATE
notes.content:
1. Add font automatic installation function
2. Solve the problem of font layout disorder
3. Change manual calibration interface prompt text
4. Add convenient operation: Click "Calibration Paper" in the manual interface prompt text to open the folder where the calibration paper file is located
5. Modify RGBD algorithm startup mode: automatically select Nvidia graphics card
6. Completely eliminate redundant files
7. Add configuration information check and corresponding prompts
8. Solving the problem of low icon resolution in software generated shortcuts
Other statements:
    Hello users who originally used the RGB free solution. If you are unable to experience or use this update properly, we apologize for temporarily disappointing your expectations. Due to the mismatch in certain environments where the RGB scheme supports algorithm operation, our engineers have been fully committed to adapting. Could you please give us some more time? Please be patient and look forward to future updates.

notes.title: Update Originjumpwork Ver2.3.4 (Beta)
notes.content:
Update prompt: Due to driver updates, it is necessary to log in to the software first, then open the streaming software to complete the streaming, and finally click the "Streaming to steamvr" button to take effect without opening the streaming software
Other updates:
1. Implemented non first time automatic login for Steam users
2. We found that many users cannot find the option to change their language the first time they enter. The language defaults to English
3. After the software is turned on, it defaults to running logic optimization
4. Optimize the software using RGBD scheme using logic (insert the camera and directly enter the dual camera calibration interface, with automatic memory function. If it is not the first calibration, it will automatically enter the serial preparation interface. If you need to recalibrate, you can return to the automatic calibration interface with one click)
5. Optimize the status and usage status of some buttons in the software
6. Add language switching function to the settings interface
7. Optimize driving capabilities in RGBD solutions
8. In the RGBD scheme, the number of trackers has been increased to 7, and elbow joint points have been added. We originally intended to add 9, but we encountered some problems in actual testing
9. Removed unnecessary files from the directory
Our Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302940

notes.title: Update Originjumpwork Ver2.3.3 (Beta)
notes.content:
Thank you for your support! Thanks for your encouragement for Jumpworkers. On May 3rd, we completed the version update for Originjumpwork Ver2.3.3 (Beta). This update requires uninstalling the old version and performing a fresh installation. We have updated and fixed the following issues:

1、Updated RGB (GPU version) new algorithm (still free)
2、Interface layout optimization
3、Fixed the disappearing taskbar logo issue
4、Resolved the lagging issue when transitioning to the main interface after login
5、Fixed some issues causing RGB full-body tracking crashes when streaming to Steam VR

Our Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302940
